## Activity

During March 2023, Central Eye Clinic recorded 224 captures. This represents the site’s reported activity for the month. The capture volume provides the basis for subsequent image-quality review and grading.

## Image quality

Of the 224 captures, 3 were assessed as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 1.3. This indicates that most images were suitable for review. Staff reported no new equipment faults during the month.

## Grading

A total of 56 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 2. These results reflect the grading activity associated with captures completed at Central Eye Clinic during March 2023.
